description: A electronics store sells premium desktops with more power as well as regular desktops for everyday use. Each premium desktop costs the store $2000 to make and yields a profit of $500. Each regular desktop costs the store $1000 to make and yields a profit of $300. The store sells at most 200 desktops each month and wants to spend at most $300000 on making the desktops. How many of each should be made and sold to maximize profit?

ManufacturingCostPremiumDesktop.definition: Manufacturing cost of a premium desktop

ManufacturingCostRegularDesktop.definition: Manufacturing cost of a regular desktop

MaxDesktopSales.definition: Maximum number of desktops sold per month

MaxManufacturingBudget.definition: Maximum spending on making the desktops

objective.description: "The goal is to maximize the total profit from producing and selling premium and regular desktops"

constraints.description: The total number of premium and regular desktops sold per month should not exceed MaxDesktopSales
The total manufacturing cost of premium and regular desktops should not exceed MaxManufacturingBudget
The number of premium and regular desktops produced and sold should be non-negative

PremiumDesktops.definition: Number of premium desktops made and sold per month

RegularDesktops.definition: Number of regular desktops made and sold per month
